review: The primary reader inspected the whole scan, both overlapping halves, and all six broad blocks enlarged 3×, reading every word and formula against C and H. Sixteen 6× details and four wider 7× details covered every C doubt, overwritten word, field subscript and decisive sign. The dense left margin was read in rotated 5×/6× crops, finally clockwise 24° for an upright baseline; section 4 was rotated clockwise 20°. The surprising live assertions were retained without mathematical repair. Context remained closed.
